subject.title: Use shared Spark subscription review rails

question: Should this repository forward CLAWSWEEPER_DISPATCH_TOKEN to the pinned shared Spark reusable workflow for review publication?
rationale: This changes the repository's credential trust boundary, while the asserted owner approval is only in the PR description and no maintainer discussion confirms its scope.

options.title: Approve the scoped relay boundary
options.body: Confirm that the pinned relay and dispatch-token scope are authorized, then require redacted live-run evidence before merge.

options.title: Keep review execution local
options.body: Retain a repository-local review workflow if the shared relay should not receive this repository credential.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped relay boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that the pinned relay and dispatch-token scope are authorized, then require redacted live-run evidence before merge.
